card.name: Category word before a number or numeral
card.fires_on: A category noun such as class, clause, genotype, types or score that is about to be followed by a number or numeral naming the specific item. It appears in medical classifications and in legal article citations.

modes.label: Classification noun before number
modes.description: A noun like class, genotype, types or score that is followed by a numeral or roman numeral.
modes.example: except obese<< class>> II and III

modes.label: Legal clause citation
modes.description: The word clause after a section reference in constitutional or statute text, followed by a number.
modes.example: Article 1, §8,<< clause>> 16 grants to Congress the power
